credits.title: Steadfast Woman
credits.overview: This film centers on the ups and downs of an ordinary woman, Chunxia, chronicling her journey of growth — swept along by fate and healing herself amid suffering.

credits.title: The Tree In The Rain
credits.overview: The movie is based on the true story of an official in Sichuan Province who died in the line of duty in 2011 when a flood struck his area.
